title: CG Implementation Patterns - KarmaCash Standards
description: Provides detailed coding standards, file structure, UI/UX principles, and testing guidelines for KarmaCash PWA development.

design_principles_summary.source_reference: KarmaCash Creative and Attractive UI Design Rule
design_principles_summary.mobile_first_pwa: Design for small screens first, then scale up. Ensure touch-friendliness (min 44x44px targets).
design_principles_summary.visual_hierarchy_whitespace: Embrace whitespace and clear hierarchy. Highlight important data.
design_principles_summary.interactive_elements_microinteractions: Add purposeful micro-interactions for responsiveness. Use subtle animations.
design_principles_summary.data_visualization: Transform raw numbers into meaningful visual representations (e.g., progress bars, charts over plain lists).
design_principles_summary.empty_states_guidance: Make empty states helpful, guiding users on next steps (e.g., include action buttons).
design_principles_summary.color_usage_visual_interest: Use color strategically for guidance and visual interest. Create depth with subtle shadows and layering.
design_principles_summary.zen_principles: Maintain Calm, Minimalist, Clarity, Responsive, and Consistent design.

coding_standards.javascript: ES6+ with JSDoc comments for functions and complex logic. Prioritize clarity and maintainability.

react.components: Functional components with hooks (useState, useEffect, useContext, custom hooks).
react.props: Use PropTypes or TypeScript for prop validation in larger components.
react.state_management: Prefer React Context for global state; consider Zustand or Redux Toolkit for more complex needs if Context becomes unwieldy.
react.performance: Memoize components with React.memo where appropriate. Use useMemo/useCallback for expensive calculations/functions.

styling.method: CSS Modules with Japandi-inspired design (natural colors, minimalism). Tailwind CSS is also used; ensure consistency.
styling.variables: Use CSS custom properties for themeable values (colors, spacing, fonts).

firebase.firestore: Structure data for efficient querying. Use listeners for real-time updates. Implement security rules.
firebase.functions: Callable functions for backend logic. Ensure proper error handling and idempotency where applicable.

code_quality_tools.formatter: Prettier (ensure code is formatted before committing)
code_quality_tools.general: Write clean, readable, and self-documenting code. Keep functions small and focused.

testing_guidelines.unit_tests: Use Vitest for unit testing components, hooks, and utility functions. Aim for good coverage of critical logic.
testing_guidelines.integration_tests: Test interactions between components and services.
testing_guidelines.end_to_end_tests: (Future consideration) Tools like Playwright or Cypress for E2E testing critical user flows.
testing_guidelines.general: Ensure tests are reliable, fast, and easy to maintain. Test edge cases and error conditions.

accessibility_a11y.importance: Ensure the application is accessible to all users.
guidelines: Provide text alternatives for non-text content (alt attributes for images).
Use ARIA attributes where necessary to enhance semantics for assistive technologies.
accessibility_a11y.tools: Consider using browser dev tools and automated checkers (e.g., Axe) for audits.
